preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 200000 and n % 2 == 0 for n in ns_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an even integer between 2 and 2*10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and len(s) == n and all(c in '01' for c in s) for s, n in zip(s_list, ns_list))
preconditions.description: For each test case, s is a string of length n consisting only of '0' and '1'.
The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout_lines) == 1 + 2 * sum(1 for line in stdout_lines if line.strip() == 'YES' or line.strip() == 'NO')
postconditions.description: The output structure matches the number of test cases: for each case, either a single 'NO' line or a 'YES' line followed by two sequence lines.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() in ('YES', 'NO')) or (len(line.strip()) == n and all(c in '()' for c in line.strip())) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is either 'YES'/'NO' (case-insensitive) or a bracket sequence of length n containing only '(' and ')'.

postconditions.expression: all(is_balanced(seq) for seq in [line.strip() for line in stdout_lines if len(line.strip()) == n])
postconditions.description: Every output bracket sequence is balanced (valid parenthesis sequence).

postconditions.expression: all((s[i] == '1' and a[i] == b[i]) or (s[i] == '0' and a[i] != b[i]) for i in range(n) for s, a, b in zip(s_list, a_list, b_list))
postconditions.description: For every position i in every test case, if s[i] is '1' then a[i] equals b[i], and if s[i] is '0' then a[i] differs from b[i].

postconditions.expression: all(not (line.strip() in ('YES', 'NO')) or (line.strip() in ('YES', 'NO') and next_line in ('YES', 'NO') or len(next_line) == n) for line, next_line in zip(stdout_lines, stdout_lines[1:]))
postconditions.description: If a line is 'YES', the next line must be a bracket sequence; if 'NO', the next line (if exists) must be the start of the next test case ('YES' or 'NO').
